title: Year 13 Dress-Up Week – White Lies
excerpt: Year 13 is celebrating Dress-Up Week with a different theme each day. Yesterday’s theme was White Lies!
body:
Year 13 is bringing plenty of fun and creativity to Dress-Up Week, with a different theme each day!

Yesterday, students embraced the White Lies theme, showing off their cheeky statements and creative outfit ideas.

Check out some of the highlights from the day! What will the next theme bring?
